summary:
AstroGuard Health Intelligence is an AI-powered healthcare and mission-control platform designed to monitor and manage astronauts’ health during space missions. The system collects real-time biometric data, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, glucose levels and other vital health information.

The platform includes an Astronaut Portal, Doctor Portal and Mission Control Dashboard. Astronauts can track their health, nutrition and medical reports while communicating securely with assigned doctors through chat, audio and video support. Doctors can monitor astronaut conditions, review clinical reports, respond to emergencies and share important updates with mission control.

An integrated AI Health Assistant helps analyze reports, provide health summaries, answer questions and identify possible health concerns. The emergency alert system allows astronauts to send distress notifications, which can be reviewed by doctors and forwarded to the mission-control authority for quick decision-making.

Overall, AstroGuard aims to provide secure, intelligent and real-time healthcare support for astronauts, improving medical monitoring, emergency response and mission safety.
details:
Astro Guard – Astronaut Health Monitoring and Emergency Alert System

Astro Guard is a digital health monitoring and emergency alert platform designed to support astronaut health and well-being during space missions. Astronauts may experience various health challenges in space, including changes in blood pressure, sleep patterns, and other physiological conditions. Monitoring these health indicators and communicating critical information to medical teams is essential for astronaut safety.

Our platform provides a centralized system where astronauts can record and monitor their health information, while medical officers can review health records and identify potential health concerns. The system also includes administrative controls and mission control support to improve coordination and health data management.

Key Features:

  • Astronaut Dashboard: Allows astronauts to access their profiles, submit health information, and monitor their health records.
  • Health Monitoring: Supports tracking important health indicators, including blood pressure, sleep patterns, and other health-related measurements.
  • Medical Officer Dashboard: Enables medical personnel to review astronaut health records and monitor submitted information.
  • Emergency Alert System: Helps communicate urgent health concerns to the relevant medical and mission support personnel.
  • Administrative Dashboard: Provides administrative control over users, roles, and platform management.
  • Mission Control Support: Helps improve communication and coordination between astronauts and relevant support teams.

Technology and Tools:

The project was developed using the MERN stack approach, including MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js, along with modern web development technologies. The platform focuses on a user-friendly interface, structured health data management, and role-based access control.

Innovation and Creativity:

Astro Guard combines astronaut health record management, medical monitoring, and emergency communication into one centralized digital platform. Its role-based system allows different stakeholders to access relevant information according to their responsibilities.

Intended Impact:

Our goal is to contribute to safer and more effective space missions by improving astronaut health monitoring, supporting early identification of potential health concerns, and strengthening communication between astronauts, medical officers, and mission support teams. In the future, the platform could be expanded with real-time wearable sensor integration and intelligent health risk analysis.
